answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 20301 Country: Pakistan Title: I searched for this dream before asking it, but was unable to find it. I saw this dream almost an hour before Fajar Namaz. I saw that My boss from head office comes to our branch office and gives order to move things from branch office to company warehouse in different city and dont even tells me or ask me that these things are required or not, after that he is talking to me in good mood and asking questions about business and while he is asking questions he is rubbing his toes on my face, and I'm replying his questions. later it is Namaz time (Not Fajar) and Me, My boss and his younger brother (he also works in the same company) leaves for Namaz (i dont know what namaz it was) and there are two Masjids, we dont go the near by masjid (that is in fornt of the office) but go to a Masjid that is on the back of the office. We all start making wudu and after that I cant see my boss but only his brother is their with me. at this point I woke up. Please advise what this Dream Means, as I'm facing problems in my office since my boss brother has started working in this company and I really want to switch my company. JAZAK ALLAH KHAIR Answer ID: 20301 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 489/390/H=1431) It is a nice dream. It indicates that the hopes regarding the job shall not be fulfilled in the present situation. It is better to switch over the company on appropriate time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
